claim_scope: Students build a learned RGB patch encoder, bidirectional ViT, connector, explicit multimodal word sequence and causal word decoder, then train answers/captions and generate through EOS. Three CPU seeds and four trained modality/pairing modes are frozen on development before all final conditions. Familiar generation is strong; excluded color-shape caption combinations fail and remain visible. Region/stage interventions retain all pairs and all background/unrestricted random draws with explicit joint-correct denominators and full-sequence controls. A separate four-mode seed-0 CUDA study provides fresh hardware evidence. Neither the categorical warm-up nor stored metrics stand in for the complete word learner.

gpu_test.full_path: Complete three-seed CPU learner plus separate fresh four-mode seed-0 CUDA training, frozen generation and stage/region controls. Compositional failures are retained.

safety_notes: All images and language are course-generated colored shapes and simple questions.
The vocabulary and visual world are narrow; no open-domain VLM or paper-scale replication claim is made.
Unseen-combination caption failures are retained and do not select or reject checkpoints.
The learner runs on CPU; the report labels its separate fresh CUDA experiments explicitly.
